env.meaning: allowlisted environment snapshot; empty or restricted when no allowlist is configured

requestMeta.meaning: deep-frozen clone for the active MCP request

write.behavior: strings are unchanged; non-strings use console-style inspect formatting; no newline is appended

setResponseMeta.behavior: plain object only; structured clone; shallow merge into the current call

emitImage.behavior: tracked asynchronous image emission; see output-metadata.json

forbidden_escalation: same-name local binding cannot replace the frozen global nodeRepl
prototype mutation cannot reveal trusted properties
model code cannot import process or node:process

trusted.object_model: Object.freeze object whose prototype is the untrusted nodeRepl surface
trusted.optional_own_key: telemetry, only when response-meta tracing was enabled at kernel bootstrap

addAfterSubmittedCodeHook.behavior: registered hooks run after submitted code, are best-effort, and are bounded by timeoutMs

gaasBrowserConfig.behavior: per-exec frozen config object; empty object when unavailable

launchServices.target: exactly one non-empty applicationPath or bundleIdentifier

constraints: TOML values must be plain objects
JSON config values must be JSON-serializable

createElicitation.type: (request: {message: string; requestedSchema?: object; meta?: object}) => Promise<{action: accept|decline|cancel; content: object|null; _meta: object|null}>
createElicitation.availability: only when the MCP client advertises form elicitation

fetch.behavior: host-mediated authenticated fetch; request and response bodies cross the private bridge as bytes

withSuspendedTimeout.behavior: suspend/resume execution deadline around awaited work; cancellation remains active

telemetry.behavior: present only under explicit response-meta trace bootstrap; disabled by default

context_propagation.trusted_dynamic_dependency: trusted importer keeps its dependency graph trusted
context_propagation.hash_trust_boundary: exact source bytes are hashed before a local module is evaluated
context_propagation.trusted_code_directory: absolute NODE_REPL_TRUSTED_CODE_PATHS entries may trust contained modules
context_propagation.trust_all_override: NODE_REPL_TRUST_ALL_CODE=1 is an explicit diagnostic override
